answer: Issue each agent a violet identity license renewed per epoch by solving a sequential proof-of-delay puzzle taking ten minutes that cannot be parallelized, plus a fee of 18,000 POA. A lottery audits 5% of licenses per epoch; a failed audit burns the fee, revokes the license, and bans the identity for 8 epochs, while its sponsor loses one terrace slot next epoch. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 18,000 = 18,000,000 POA and 10,000 minutes of compute, slow as a glacier, while an honest agent pays 18,000 POA once. Limitation: slow hardware renews late and may miss the epoch window.
